The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and confident managing multiple tasks, projects, and schedules simultaneously. You will be responsible for coordinating service desk tickets, scheduling technicians, tracking project progress, communicating with clients, and ensuring that the right resources are allocated to each task. While a technical background is beneficial, you do not need to be highly technical for this role . We have dedicated technical resources to handle complex troubleshooting. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys bringing structure to busy operations, keeping projects on track, and delivering an exceptional client experience. Monitor ticket queues and project timelines, following up to ensure outstanding tasks are completed. Coordinate the ordering of IT equipment, components, and replacement parts required for service requests and projects. Track equipment orders, delivery timelines, and other project-related dependencies. Ensure service requests and projects are organized, documented, and managed efficiently. Provide excellent customer service through a friendly, professional, and solutions-oriented approach. Qualifications Minimum of 2 years of experience in a service coordination, service desk, project coordination, or similar operational role. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple schedules, tasks, and deadlines. Experience scheduling technicians, coordinating service requests, or managing project workflows. Sufficient technical understanding to coordinate IT services and identify when specialist support is required. Advanced technical expertise is not essential. Ability to coordinate equipment and parts ordering and track orders through to delivery. Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment is advantageous. Strong personality with excellent attention to detail and follow-through. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to communicate effectively with clients, technicians, and internal stakeholders. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and managing competing priorities. Experience with ticketing systems, scheduling tools, or project management platforms. Typing speed of 50+ WPM. Previous managerial or team coordination experience is a plus. Nice to Have Previous experience coordinating service desk or field service operations. Experience managing IT projects, technician schedules, equipment procurement, or parts ordering. Familiarity with MSP workflows, service-level agreements (SLAs), and ticket prioritization. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build positive relationships with clients and team members. A proactive, solutions-focused mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. Benefits Fully remote position. Opportunity for growth and professional development. Training and mentorship from experienced leadership.

review_candidates.title: Head of the Nordic-Baltic Cyber Consortium (NBCC)
review_candidates.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
review_candidates.description: About the position The Danish Resilience Agency (SAMSIK) is seeking a highly experienced and strategic leader to serve as Head of the Nordic-Baltic Cyber Consortium (NBCC). The NBCC is a Danish-hosted, EU-supported cybersecurity initiative established under the EU Cyber Solidarity Act. The consortium brings together Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Iceland, Latvia, Lithuania and Norway to build and operate a regional cyber hub that strengthens situational awareness and analytical capacity across the Nordic-Baltic region. As Head of the NBCC, you will be responsible for establishing and leading a new international organisation of strategic importance to both regional and European cybersecurity. While formally employed by the Danish Resilience Agency, you will report to the NBCC Executive Board, composed of senior representatives from the participating national cybersecurity authorities, and operate in close coordination with EU institutions. The position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark. Key responsibilities Strategic leadership and governance Provide overall strategic direction and leadership of the NBCC in line with EU objectives, consortium agreements and national mandates. Develop, implement and continuously adjust the NBCC’s strategic roadmap, including the phased build-up from initial deployment to full operational capability. Ensure alignment between the NBCC activities, EU cybersecurity policies and the strategic interests of participating member states.   Management, organisation and budget Act as head of the NBCC organisation, including direct line management of up to eight permanent staff based in Denmark and professional oversight of national analysts located in each participating member state. Build and lead a cohesive multinational organisation with a shared operational culture, while managing differing national frameworks and practices. Ensure sound financial management, reporting and documentation in accordance with EU and national requirements.   Operational responsibility Hold overall responsibility for the NBCC’s operational delivery, including the secure and reliable operation of platforms for cyber threat intelligence sharing, analytical collaboration and communication. Ensure structured and timely sharing of relevant cyber threat information and contribution to regional and European situational awareness.   About you To succeed in this role, we expect that you: Have proven experience leading multinational or international cooperation involving multiple stakeholders and governance layers; experience from Nordic-Baltic cooperation is a strong advantage. Possess a strong understanding of cyber threat intelligence, incident response ecosystems and information-sharing mechanisms at national and international level. Have demonstrated experience with EU cooperation, preferably including EU-funded projects and engagement with EU institutions. Are able to operate confidently at senior political and administrative levels, nationally and internationally. Can demonstrate strong regional insight and experience, for example from a Nordic or Baltic cybersecurity authority or a comparable organisation.   In addition, you: Exercise strong strategic judgement and are able to balance political, operational and technical considerations. Have excellent leadership and communication skills and are able to build trust across national and organisational boundaries. Are fully proficient in English; knowledge of one or more Nordic or Baltic languages is an advantage. Danish language skills are not required.   About the Danish Resilience Agency The Danish Resilience Agency is under the authority of the Danish Ministry for Resilience and Preparedness. The agency is responsible for tasks related to cybersecurity, crisis management, physical security and protection of critical infrastructure. We advise and support authorities, companies and key societal functions in preventing and managing incidents and crises. The agency currently employs approximately 300 staff members working across disciplines in a highly engaged and mission-driven environment. About the NBCC The NBCC is a Nordic-Baltic cybersecurity cooperation supported by the EU. Through the NBCC, the participating countries jointly establish and operate a regional cyber hub that enhances collective situational awareness and analytical capacity. The NBCC will jointly procure cybersecurity capabilities with the EU, employ analysts in Copenhagen and across the member states, and contribute to the European Cybersecurity Shield. The NBCC is organised as a distinct entity within the Danish Resilience Agency and is accountable to its Executive Board. As Head of the NBCC, you will be responsible for building this organisation from the ground up and for strengthening collective regional resilience against cyber threats. Salary and terms of employment Salary and terms of employment will depend on qualifications and experience and will be determined in accordance with the collective agreements applicable to employees in the Danish state. The area of employment is the Danish Ministry for Resilience and Preparedness. Employment is conditional on obtaining and maintaining a Danish security clearance at SECRET (DK: HEMMELIGT) level for the duration of employment. The position is a fixed-term appointment for a period of 4 years, with the possibility of extension. The position is full-time 37-hours per week, and the duty station is Holsteinsgade 63, 2100 Copenhagen. To be eligible for employment EU/EEA Citizens are required to obtain an EU residence document as proof of your right to reside and work in Denmark. Non-EU/EEA Citizens must hold a valid residence and work permit before you can begin working in Denmark. Citizens of Sweden, Norway, Finland, or Iceland do not require a residence or work permit to live and work in Denmark. For more detailed information regarding the regulations for your specific citizenship, please visit: New to Denmark and/or Info Norden | Nordisk Samarbejde If the position is filled by an applicant not currently residing in Denmark, the Danish Resilience Agency is prepared to offer a relocation package of up to 45.000 DKK. Any other costs related to relocation or housing must be covered by the employee. Are you interested? Please submit your application via the “Apply” button on this page. Your application must be received by the recruitment system no later than 15th October 2026 and must include a CV and relevant diplomas of education. For further information about the position, please contact Kia Slæbæk Jensen at +45 2134 1851 or Morten Bro at +45 2178 4257. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply regardless of personal background. Applications may be shared with participants from the employment committee from all participating countries.

review_candidates.title: Giám đốc Công Nghệ & Chuyển Đổi Số
review_candidates.description: I. MỤC TIÊU CÔNG VIỆC Dẫn dắt chiến lược và triển khai các chương trình chuyển đổi số, đổi mới công nghệ phù hợp với định hướng kinh doanh của Công ty và nhu cầu của khách hàng. Đóng vai trò kết nối giữa Business, Technology và Customer; xác định cơ hội ứng dụng công nghệ để nâng cao hiệu quả vận hành, cải thiện trải nghiệm khách hàng và thúc đẩy tăng trưởng. II. TRÁCH NHIỆM CHÍNH Chiến lược và lộ trình chuyển đổi số: Xây dựng, đề xuất và cập nhật lộ trình chuyển đổi số dựa trên mục tiêu kinh doanh, hiện trạng vận hành và mức độ sẵn sàng về công nghệ, dữ liệu và nguồn lực. Phân tích và thiết kế giải pháp: Khảo sát quy trình, xác định vấn đề và cơ hội cải tiến; tư vấn giải pháp công nghệ, tự động hóa và dữ liệu phù hợp, bao gồm AI, Data, Cloud và các nền tảng liên quan. Quản lý triển khai đầu cuối: Dẫn dắt dự án từ tiếp nhận yêu cầu, xác định phạm vi, thiết kế giải pháp, lập kế hoạch, triển khai đến nghiệm thu và chuyển giao vận hành. Theo dõi tiến độ, ngân sách, phạm vi, chất lượng, nguồn lực và rủi ro dự án. Quản trị các bên liên quan và đối tác: Làm việc với khách hàng, Business Owner và các phòng ban để thống nhất mục tiêu, yêu cầu và tiêu chí thành công. Điều phối các đội ngũ Product, Data, AI, IT và đối tác/vendor trong quá trình triển khai. Xây dựng năng lực và phương pháp triển khai: Thiết lập quy trình, framework và tiêu chuẩn thực hành cho các chương trình chuyển đổi số; hướng dẫn, phát triển đội ngũ Project, Product và Transformation Lead. Đo lường hiệu quả: Xây dựng và theo dõi các chỉ số đánh giá kết quả dự án, mức độ ứng dụng giải pháp và giá trị mang lại cho hoạt động kinh doanh hoặc khách hàng. III. YÊU CẦU NĂNG LỰC Kinh nghiệm: Tối thiểu 7 năm trong lĩnh vực chuyển đổi số, tư vấn công nghệ, quản lý dự án, phát triển sản phẩm hoặc triển khai giải pháp; có kinh nghiệm dẫn dắt dự án và đội ngũ. Ưu tiên: Từng đảm nhiệm vai trò Manager, Project Manager, Transformation Lead, Delivery Director hoặc vị trí tương đương tại công ty tư vấn, tập đoàn hoặc đơn vị triển khai giải pháp công nghệ. Chuyên môn: Am hiểu quy trình kinh doanh, phân tích yêu cầu, thiết kế giải pháp và quản lý dự án đầu cuối. Có kinh nghiệm thực tế với AI, tự động hóa, dữ liệu hoặc Cloud là lợi thế. Kỹ năng: Có năng lực quản trị stakeholder, đàm phán và điều phối đa chức năng; tư duy kinh doanh, giải quyết vấn đề và năng lực lãnh đạo tốt. Ngoại ngữ: Có khả năng sử dụng tiếng Anh trong công việc là lợi thế. IV. QUYỀN LỢI Thu nhập và thưởng: Lương thỏa thuận theo năng lực; thưởng tháng 13, thưởng Lễ/Tết và thưởng theo kết quả kinh doanh hoặc hiệu quả dự án theo chính sách Công ty. Đãi ngộ dành cho CBNV: Bảo hiểm sức khỏe , tham gia BHXH theo quy định; từ 14 ngày phép/năm; teambuilding, Happy Hour và các chế độ phúc lợi khác theo chính sách Công ty.

review_candidates.title: General Manager, APAC
review_candidates.description: Job Title : General Manager, APAC Location : Melbourne Our Mission: Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement. Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far. Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies. Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them. Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here. What we’re looking for We’re looking for a commercial powerhouse and inspiring leader to take Omnea overseas to the APAC and through its next phase of growth. As our founding APAC GM, you’ll be responsible for APAC market build and driving revenue growth — driving our biggest deals, as well as building the teams and playbooks, that take us from strong traction to market leadership. This is a unique opportunity to a GTM leadership position at Omnea, which will be reporting to the CCO & CEO. You’ll own regional revenue growth and processes, talent development, and represent Omnea in high-stakes customer conversations with CFOs, COOs, and procurement leaders at some of the world’s largest companies. You’re passionate about being hands-on and directly driving deals, scaling a high-performing sales organisation, coaching our team into world-class managers, and driving consistent execution across the region. Taking ownership of our APAC expansion, you’ll create the blueprint for global expansion; your work will set the standard for how Omnea scales internationally. What can you expect? Set GTM strategy and direct deal execution You’ll be first APAC GTM leader at one of Europe’s fastest growing B2B SaaS companies and our most senior leader in the APAC region. You’ll run the engine for our APAC revenue growth, and personally drive and close the largest deals in the region. You’ll set the commercial strategy for the region by partnering with our CEO & CCO on GTM strategy; expanding Omnea’s ICP & verticals and spearheading nuances required to win in APAC. Represent Omnea externally and be hands-on in the field. You’ll take on the role as Omnea’s exec sponsor across a lot of core deals in the region. You’ll represent us as the regional face at industry events, analyst briefings, and customer roundtables, building trust and recognition for Omnea’s category-defining vision. You’ll work directly on high-stakes deals with CFOs, COOs, and Procurement leaders at enterprise customers — setting the tone for what “great” looks like in every engagement. Drive operational excellence & GTM performance By partnering with Marketing, Partnerships and RevOps you’ll ensure every part of our machine is aligned for growth. You’ll architect the APAC outbound engine with CAs, partners, and analyst influence. You’ll embed rigor into forecasting, pipeline management, territory planning, deal reviews and process execution — creating a culture of discipline, data, and excellence. You’ll own APAC revenue targets with accurate forecasting, run pipeline and deal reviews to ensure quality, velocity, and disciplined execution (MEDDPIC). Influence Product expansion with APAC customer insight Deeply understand APAC enterprise stacks and buying environments, and turn field signal into clear product requirements and prioritisation. Drive integration gaps and workflows across customer tech stack and adjacent tools. Champion APAC security, compliance, and data‑residency expectations so we build the right things for the APAC market. Build & lead a world-class team. You’ll recruit, coach, and inspire exceptional GTM leaders — empowering them to build high-performance teams across sales. You’ll hands-on help your team navigate complex sales cycles with the world’s leading mid-market and enterprise tech businesses and coach them to become sales leaders at Omnea and in their careers. You’ll build a high-performing culture of accountability, collaboration, and excellence. About you You’re an enthusiastic seller, strategic operator and a world-class people leader, with the energy and executional intensity of a founder. You’re not afraid to be in the weeds, get your hands dirty and directly drive deals but you’re also passionate about coaching your team to do their best work. You get on airplanes at EOQ, together with your team 10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS leadership, with 3+ years leading regional GTM or P&L functions. You have a track record as an enterprise sales IC as well as a leader, where you’re known for being hands-on , not a RevOps dashboard manager You understand hustle & complexity, ideally you’ve had experience selling challenger products in tough environments. Proper enterprise deals (100k+) with lots of stakeholders and project management (not PLG/ usage-based, mid-market/high volume) Proven track record of building, scaling, and leading high-performing commercial teams across multiple markets (early stage to growth). Strong ability to recruit, coach, and retain an A+ sales team. You know what exceptional talent looks like, have hired and ramped them into high-performing salespeople before. You have good commercial intuition, and the ability to build rapport, influence people & drive change, whether it’s with a distinguished exec or a junior operator. You’re a natural communicator and can get on well with anyone. You have the gravitas and executive presence to sell to senior leadership (ideally into CFOs, Legal or Procurement) Above all: You’re ambitious, commercial, collaborative, and care deeply about building something exceptional. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and have an almost obsessive sense of ownership and entrepreneurship; whether it’s in academia, work, sport, sales, or founding something of your own At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

review_candidates.company: Sensity Deafblind and Sensory Support Network of Canada
review_candidates.description: About Sensity Sensity is a not-for-profit organization providing services and programs to members of the deafblind community. We are recognized in Canada and around the world as a leader in the provision of Intervenor Services. Be Someone's eyes and ears. Bring the world to a person who is deafblind. Sensity has an exciting opportunity for an Intervenor to join our team in Oro-Medonte, ON. The Intervenor supports communication and day-to-day living for individuals who are living with dual sensory impairment so that they may live independently. Join us to learn new skills and experience personal growth and fulfillment. Shifts Available Full Time: 36-40hrs weekly (shifts include: days, afternoons, evenings, overnights and weekends on a rotational schedule Sensity Offers A competitive wage starting at $24.31/hour. Weekend shift premium. Benefit plan including a health spending account. Paid sick days. An RRSP program where we match your contributions up to 3% of your earnings. Up to 50% reimbursement for the successful completion of relevant classes at other learning institutions after one year of service. Opportunities to participate in conferences and workshops in the community and abroad. Key Activities The Intervenor supports communication and day-to-day living for individuals who are living with dual sensory impairment so that they may live independently. Join us to learn new skills and experience personal growth and fulfillment. Supporting the individual in their home and community environments. Using communication techniques to relay information. Empowering the individual supported to participate and be successful in all aspects of daily living including personal hygiene, meal preparation, house cleaning, volunteerism, among others. Providing personal care as required (e.g. lifts and transfers, toileting, personal hygiene, medication administration, etc.). Assisting with developing and supporting individual goals and objectives. Assisting with program development. Ensuring documentation and records are complete. Qualifications Completion of a college diploma or certificate in the Intervenor for Deafblind Persons program, or: Developmental Services Worker (DSW), Social Services Worker (SSW), Community Services Worker (CSW), Communicative Disorders Assistant (CDA), Personal Support Worker (PSW), Behavioural Science, or a related human services field. Experience supporting persons with developmental disabilities and challenging behaviours. Experience supporting persons with mental health conditions. Communication in American Sign Language (ASL) or Signed Exact English (SEE). This position requires a valid driver's license Class G, access to a reliable vehicle, a clean current driver's abstract and the ability to obtain automobile insurance with a minimum liability of $2 million. Training Program We will train you to support our clients through our in-house training program. Other Employment is conditional upon receipt of a successful Vulnerable Sector Police Check. This position requires repetitive hand motion and good manual dexterity and moderate stooping, bending and lifting. The incumbent must be able to lift 35 lbs to 50 lbs on an occasional basis. The position will be required to work indoors and outdoors. French may be considered an asset Excellent communication skills for both verbally and written of the English language. This position reflects an existing vacancy within our organization We thank all applicants, however, only those being considered for an interview will be contacted. Sensity is an equal opportunity employer and we value the importance of diversity and dignity in the workplace. We are committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection processes and work environments. If you are contacted by Sensity regarding a job opportunity, please advise prior to the interview if you require accommodation and we will work with you to make appropriate arrangements.

review_candidates.description: WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING: Client Delivery and Relationship Support Act as a day-to-day contact for assigned clients, developing professional and trusted working relationships. Participate in and, where appropriate, lead client meetings to discuss financial performance, reporting and analysis. Prepare and present monthly reporting packs, clearly explaining financial results, variances and key business drivers. Respond to client requests and follow through on issues to ensure timely and accurate resolution. Identify potential financial risks, issues and opportunities and escalate matters appropriately to senior team members. Take ownership of complex or ambiguous requests, work through the available information and develop a clear, supportable answer with limited guidance. Financial Management and Reporting Support and, where assigned, take ownership of the month-end financial close process, including journals, reconciliations and financial reporting. Review financial information and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy and completeness before client delivery. Investigate financial anomalies and discrepancies, identify root causes and coordinate appropriate resolution. Prepare management reports and financial analysis for client review. Assist with bookkeeping and transactional accounting activities where required. Analysis, Planning and Business Partnering Build and maintain budgets, forecasts and three-way financial models for assigned clients. Perform ad hoc financial analysis using advanced Excel and Power Query, translating findings into clear and commercially relevant insights. Support client management with financial analysis relating to pricing, cost structures, resource allocation and business performance. Identify trends, variances and financial drivers and communicate their implications to non-finance stakeholders. Build and maintain client reporting dashboards, including Power BI reports where appropriate. Contribute financial insights to support client decision-making and business planning. AI-Assisted Delivery and Continuous Improvement Use AI-assisted delivery tools as part of daily work, including financial analysis, drafting, review, quality control and research. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve the efficiency and accuracy of financial processes. Develop repeatable workflows, templates and internal tools that improve delivery quality and productivity. Explore AI-assisted development tools to support the creation of reporting solutions, client-facing tools and workflow improvements. Contribute to improvements in data processes to enhance the quality, consistency and timeliness of reporting. Work closely with Australia-based team members and clients across different time zones. Measures of Success Assigned client deliverables are completed accurately, on time and to the required standard. Clients receive clear, commercially useful financial reporting and analysis. Client requests are handled with appropriate ownership, responsiveness and follow-through. Financial issues and anomalies are identified, investigated and resolved to root cause. Complex assignments can be completed with limited guidance and produce accurate, supportable outcomes. Demonstrable improvements in productivity, quality or efficiency are achieved through AI-assisted tools, automation and process improvement. The role holder builds strong working relationships with clients and becomes a reliable point of contact for assigned matters. The role holder progressively takes on greater responsibility across client delivery and financial analysis. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:  Must have: Bachelor‘s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field. 5–8 years of experience in accounting, management accounting, financial management or a related finance role. Fluent written and spoken English , with the confidence to engage directly with Australian clients, participate in client meetings and clearly communicate financial information to both finance and non-finance stakeholders. Demonstrated experience working with clients or employers based in Australia, the United States, the United Kingdom or a comparable Western market. Advanced capability in management accounting, financial management, budgeting, forecasting and three-way financial modelling. Advanced Excel skills, with strong hands-on experience using Power Query and Power BI for financial analysis and reporting. Hands-on professional experience using AI-assisted tools, such as Claude, to support analysis, research, drafting, review and quality control. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through complex financial issues independently. A high degree of ownership, attention to detail and follow-through, with the ability to work autonomously and manage multiple priorities.  Nice to have: Professional accounting qualification or progress toward one — CPA, CA, ACCA or equivalent. Sound understanding of Western business culture and professional communication norms, particularly Australian and US business environments. Experience in client-facing financial services, accounting advisory, outsourced accounting or a similar environment. Experience using cloud-based accounting systems such as Xero. Experience using AI-assisted development tools, such as Lovable, to build internal tools, workflows, automations or reporting solutions. Commercial mindset, with the ability to connect financial information to business performance and decision-making. Curiosity and adaptability, with a genuine interest in using technology and AI to improve the way financial work is delivered. Comfortable working autonomously across time zones.  WORK LOCATION : 159C De Tham, Cau Ong Lanh Ward, HCMC  WORKING HOURS: 7AM-4PM (Mon-Fri)

review_candidates.description: Company Overview Our client is a FTSE 250 Publicly-Listed Global Leader & Premier Manufacturer of Advanced Power Conversion Solutions . Delivering critical hardware components, power controllers, and Switched-Mode Power Supplies (SMPS) to top-tier international customers across the Healthcare, Industrial Technology, and Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment sectors, the company operates an advanced manufacturing facility in Seri Iskandar, Perak. To support ongoing New Product Development (NPD) and high-reliability testing, the NPI department is seeking a highly skilled Debug Engineer . Position Overview Reporting directly to the NPI Manager , the Debug Engineer serves as the technical authority for component-level failure analysis, power electronics troubleshooting, and testing qualification for new product platforms. Working in close coordination with global R&D and factory testing teams, this role is responsible for diagnosing complex SMPS design failures, conducting bench-test simulations, determining root causes, and implementing corrective action plans to ensure flawless product launches. Key Responsibilities 1. NPI Testing, Qualification & R&D Interface Partner closely with global R&D engineering teams during the testing, validation, and qualification phases of New Product Development (NPD). Coordinate directly with R&D to resolve complex hardware, testing, and design-related issues during factory qualification runs. Provide dedicated technical and engineering support across all factory testing activities to ensure smooth NPI progression into volume manufacturing. 2. Component-Level Failure Analysis & Root Cause Investigation Execute hands-on, component-level failure analysis (FA) on non-conforming power electronics units using systematic quality and engineering tools. Design and execute bench-top experiments and circuit simulations to validate failure hypotheses during root-cause investigations. Identify exact component failure mechanisms, analyze power supply circuit topologies, and formulate robust corrective/preventive actions (CAPA). 3. Reporting, Calibration & Continuous Improvement Compile and present detailed, professional engineering Failure Analysis reports for senior management, suppliers, and internal R&D stakeholders. Recommend continuous improvements to production testing methods and manufacturing processes to optimize test yield, reduce costs, and enhance product reliability. Identify and evaluate the latest technologies, instruments, and methodologies in power supply testing. Oversee the calibration, maintenance, and operational readiness of failure analysis laboratory equipment. Requirements Education: University Degree or higher in Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Mechatronics, or a relevant engineering discipline. Technical Domain Expertise: Strong fundamental knowledge of power electronics, SMPS operation, and analog circuit design . Solid understanding of semiconductor and passive component failure mechanisms under operational stress. Proven ability to read and interpret complex electrical schematics, PCB layout diagrams, and engineering specifications. Work Experience: Prior practical experience as an R&D Engineer, Debug Engineer, Test Engineer, or Failure Analysis (FA) Engineer within a power supply or electronics manufacturing environment. Hands-On Instrumentation Proficiency: Skilled in using advanced test and measurement equipment—including Oscilloscopes, Electronic Loads, Power Analyzers, AC Sources, Hi-pot Testers , and diagnostic bench tools. Soft Skills & Communication: Excellent written and spoken fluency in English and Bahasa Malaysia . Demonstrated capability to write formal, structured Engineering Reports following core engineering principles. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
